description: Look up what a trading card is worth and whether grading it pays. Midpoint returns current USD market prices for 1.5M+ Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Gundam, sports (baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, wrestling, UFC, golf, tennis, boxing, racing) and entertainment cards. Ask for a card by name, set or number to get its raw (ungraded) price by condition and the graded ladder for PSA, CGC, BGS, SGC and TAG. Ask whether it is worth grading to get the PSA 9 and PSA 10 premium, net profit after grading fees, expected value by gem rate and a plain verdict. You can also see 7 to 180 days of price history, the biggest 30-day movers, rising cards that actually sell, the best cards to grade in a game or set, and priced set checklists. Every answer links to the matching page on cardcenteringtool.com. No account is needed and nothing is written.

defaultPrompt: What's a 1986 Fleer Michael Jordan worth raw and PSA 10?
Which Pokémon cards moved the most this month?
What are the most valuable cards in Evolving Skies?
